anti_analysis: VMware detection: GetFileAttributesA on vmmouse.sys and vmhgfs.sys driver files
CPUID leaf 1 ECX bit 31 (hypervisor present) check
Killswitch abort: if http://example.com is reachable via InternetOpenUrlA the malware exits

injection_details.evidence: No injection-related APIs are imported (no CreateRemoteThread, VirtualAllocEx, WriteProcessMemory, OpenProcess, NtCreateThreadEx) and none are resolved dynamically. The 'worm' component (worm_propagate at 0x140001c8d) is only a TCP connect-scanner: it iterates IPs 192.0.2.1..192.0.2.445, attempts a TCP connect to port 445 (SMB) with a 2s timeout, and closes the socket on success (no exploit payload, no injection). Propagation/persistence is instead done by installing/starting an 'mssecsvc2.0' service (display name 'Microsoft Security Center (2.0)') pointing at the malware's own executable.
